newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising to 49 the number of executions this year in the country, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement carried by official Saudi Press Agency said the man was executed in the capital Riyadh after being found guilty of smuggling an unspecified amount of heroin into the country.
Conservative Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists. In May alone 23 people were beheaded.
